prompt.project_info: Create a high-fidelity photorealistic bedroom lifestyle portrait with candid social-media character, white bedding, a red textured top and soft magenta lamp glow.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long layered dark-brown hair, fair natural skin texture, a relaxed pleasant smile and direct eye contact. She wears a sparkly textured red or dark-pink triangle top with thin straps and solid black bottoms, preserving the supplied wardrobe without adding exposure.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium slightly elevated view from the top of the head to the upper thighs. The adult subject reclines diagonally against a white textured headboard, one arm raised to the headboard and the other resting near a pillow, with legs extending toward the lower right. Include messy white sheets and pillows, a crumpled dark grey or teal garment, a small white square device on the mattress and a gold floor lamp with pink shade.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused front-left interior light creates gentle skin highlights and natural shadows. The lamp adds a pink-magenta glow to the right wall and background. Keep the atmosphere relaxed, comfortable and intimate in a non-explicit lifestyle sense.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 4:5 framing, slightly elevated camera, sharp focus on face and outfit, realistic skin texture and fabric sparkle, natural body physics, soft bedding detail, restrained contrast and candid unpolished color treatment.
